rules.reason: Individual property defaults declared in OpenAPI; whole-object omission handled by request_defaults.
validation: Within a supplied preemption_policy object, omitted declared properties use its schema defaults.
rules.replace_at: request normalization; nested-object application is team choice

value.omitted_preemption_policy: materialize official per-property defaults as one object

rules.reason: No official defaults for these fields; timeout is a cap, never predicted duration.
validation: Minimal valid request needs no extension fields.

value.local: X-Owner required on tenant operations; body owner must match

rules.reason: OpenAPI owner header wiring is incomplete; challenge requires tenant isolation.
validation: Owner B cannot infer A jobs from events/metrics or fetch their artifacts.

rules.reason: OpenAPI reset summary.
validation: No allocations/jobs/leases remain after reset.

value.reset_inventory: empty; do not reload demo fixture

rules.reason: Official initialization convention not yet supplied.
validation: Reset then old attempt callback cannot repopulate inventory.

value.gpu_count: whole physical GPUs or equal-profile slices; no mixing
value.profile_match: exact when specified; null means whole GPU
value.memory_match: per GPU or slice >= requested MiB
value.parent_child: mutually exclusive; sum slices within declared physical capacity
value.infeasible: 202 Pending even if current topology has no match

rules.reason: Finite topology and complete candidate enumeration; never invent hardware.
validation: A whole GPU cannot coexist with any active slice of its parent.

rules.reason: Challenge requires idempotency; key lifecycle is unspecified.
validation: Two owners may reuse a key; 32 same-owner identical calls create one allocation.

value.renew: now + supplied ttl; omitted body/field uses original normalized ttl

rules.reason: Separate queue wait and holding time; keep one auditable lease deadline.
validation: Grant at t=20 ttl=30 expires at 50, including after preemption.

value.terminal_job: allocation returns to Allocated and keeps lease

rules.reason: Job cardinality and terminal lease behavior are not specified.
validation: A second active job is 409; completed job does not silently release its allocation.

value.allocation_stage: create allocation + bind + persist stage receipt atomically
value.commit: create job + bind + persist stage receipt in one transaction before response
value.retry: same stage and payload returns saved receipt before version check

rules.reason: Close commit-before-response crash window without altering frozen JobRequest.
validation: Kill after commit before response; retry recovers same job_id and receipt.

value.new_work: block new placements and jobs on named GPUs immediately
value.overlap: union blocked intervals; earliest active deadline governs held allocations
value.unknown_gpu: reject whole command; no partial demand

rules.reason: Repeated contributor demand and interval overlap unspecified.
validation: Overlapping recalls do not double-release or reopen a GPU before all intervals end.

value.scheduler_preemption: forbidden when either flag protects it
value.ready: request stop; release only after stop receipt
value.failed_or_timeout: stop without checkpoint; checkpoint mode becomes Evicted; others Preempted
value.resume: explicit request; Pending if no replacement; no busy retry loop

rules.reason: Contributor ownership is official; exact mode behavior is provisional.
validation: Failed checkpoint never becomes verified or resumed; recall deadline still applies.

value.manual_logical: ready may preserve declared model state; record model continuation separately, never artifact-verified or applied CPU continuation
value.cpu_realtime: requires readable verified compatible artifact to continue saved state

rules.reason: Separate acceptance of official ready report from evidence of actual execution.
validation: Ready without URI is recorded, but UI does not claim artifact verification.

value.allocation_restarts: increment when replacement execution generation is committed after interruption
value.job_retries: increment when retry generation is committed after execution failure while lease remains valid
value.mutually_exclusive: one generation charges only its triggering budget

rules.reason: Two official limits exist; their counting points are not specified.
validation: Repeated resume while waiting consumes zero; first authorized replacement consumes one.

value.scope: total elapsed logical time including retry and suspended wait
value.terminal: Failed; stop current attempt; retain allocation lease unless lease ends
value.retry: timeout is final; does not reset timer

rules.reason: Choose a finite end-to-end timeout, distinct from workload duration.
validation: Repeated resume cannot reset timeout or create unlimited lifetime.

value.Draining: no new placement; existing holds continue
value.NotReady: evict affected allocations; stop jobs; quarantine until reconciled
value.Ready: permits new placement only after reconciliation; does not revive evicted jobs

rules.reason: State enum official; effects on existing work unspecified.
validation: NotReady followed by Ready does not resurrect stale execution.

value.external: drain due events <= now before next external command; command order by committed sequence

rules.reason: At exact deadline reports cannot override already due release.
validation: One advance of 30 equals 10+20 with no intervening input; ready exactly at cutoff is late.

value.manual_logical: only explicit advance; traverse every due boundary
value.cpu_realtime: one monotonic driver advances same logical clock; no independent expiry timers
value.manual_cpu_advance: serialize; settle elapsed wall delta then manual delta; reset wall anchor once
value.cpu_stop: real acknowledgement required; unconfirmed resource quarantined
value.reset: fence old epoch; never make uncertain live execution allocatable

rules.reason: Blueprint 03 separates actual execution and deterministic simulation.
validation: Clock +100 does not fabricate CPU completion or confirmed physical stop.

value.operation: METHOD + space + frozen route template, e.g. POST /v1/jobs
value.mode: normalize strings and numeric 429/500/503 to canonical strings
value.latency: wall delay before command; executes once; does not advance logical clock
value.scope: only matching public operation; never test control

rules.reason: Official mode type says string but numeric YAML enums are unquoted.
validation: Injected 503 creates no allocation and does not reserve an idempotency success receipt.

value.metadata: only declared observable profiles; missing profile uses duration-free baseline
value.decision: record version, candidates, coverage and committed outcome

rules.reason: Official forbids scripted answers; blueprint requires prefix causality.
validation: Changing unseen future input leaves common-prefix decisions/events identical.

value.commit: one SQLite write transaction: state + ledger + events + receipt
value.version: VersionStamp(epoch,revision); stale plan has no side effects
value.events: monotonic sequence per epoch; tenant filtering before projection
value.execution: outbox intent committed first; effect callback fenced by AttemptRef generation

rules.reason: One authority and durable effects; no promises of exactly-once external processes.
validation: Crash after commit retains receipt; old generation callback cannot mutate current allocation.
